draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.23, the 73rd-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 9th of 28 at WR. He went 52nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Josh Reynolds. Testing concerns: 10-yard split (7th percentile), vertical jump (12th percentile). College production: 107 receiving yards in 2021, 28th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys. 65 career games and 55 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (13 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: receiving yards 1,429 (98th percentile), approximate value 13 (97th percentile), receiving td 9 (96th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 wide receiver who played: 1,429 receiving yards against a median of 302, above the norm.
